purpose: Deterministically combine exact independent-annotator agreements with validated role-blind adjudications and map the resulting key/complete unit sets onto the frozen Phi output-token axis.

primary_mapped_labels.allowed_use: exact character-to-token alignment carrier only; primary semantic targets have no priority

decision_rule.exact_agreement: Require primary and secondary eligibility/key/complete targets to be identical and copy that shared target.
decision_rule.disagreement: Require one structurally valid role-blind adjudication and copy its final eligibility/key/complete target.
forbidden: averaging primary and secondary binary targets
giving primary or secondary annotator role priority
using correctness, hallucination labels, or training results to change the semantic target

token_mapping_rule.axis: frozen output_token_ids from the trajectory manifest
token_mapping_rule.method: Regenerate binary token membership from final unit indices and the already validated mapped_units in primary_mapped_labels.
required_checks: item, private lineage, source row, and mapping-carrier identities agree
source response exactly equals the blind trajectory
output_token_ids SHA256 agrees across lineage, source, and mapping carrier
mapped unit text/character spans exactly equal private lineage
mapped token spans are ordered, in range, and reproduce the frozen primary target when primary unit indices are remapped
final key and complete targets are non-empty and key is a pointwise subset of complete

split_rule.training_access: Only dense_train supervision may enter optimization; localization_dev labels are evaluation-only.

allowed_conclusion_if_passed: The 64-row adjudicated dual-prior unit targets are exactly mapped to frozen Phi tokens and may enter the preregistered standalone D0-D3 learnability pilot; no mechanism or downstream reward improvement has yet been shown.
